summary: PHP Ventures Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a $957.30 deposit into its trust account to extend the deadline for completing an initial business combination by one month, from June 16, 2026 to July 16, 2026. The extension is intended to provide additional time to consummate a de-SPAC transaction. The company had previously been suspended from trading on Nasdaq on April 19, 2024, with a Form 25 filed on June 28, 2024. No specific target, deal terms, or premium were disclosed. What to watch: the company's ability to find and close a business combination before the extended deadline; risk-arb angle: further extensions or liquidation may occur if no deal is reached.
